parsed.why: National seat: national passport, entry-screening and visa exposures apply directly, plus a national-legislature-imposed facilities restriction. No local ban and a July 2026 low-risk listing put it above the 0.35 national line, but national override caps it.

Own March 2025 law bans entry to opposite-birth-sex multi-occupancy restrooms, changing rooms and sleeping quarters, with a private cause of action — universal exposure reaching every visitor — plus worst-tier trans legislation, no state hate-crime or nondiscrimination cover.

Mob beat a trans couple over restroom use; attackers unarrested while victims were charged, one denied hospital care, jailed and strip-searched in a men's facility despite her female marker. Thin recourse, no GI hate-crime or discrimination cover, severe municipal ordinance.

Strong protective machinery actually operating: facilities access guaranteed by law, GI discrimination and hate-crime statutes enforced (incl. murder conviction), conversion-therapy ban, court-ordered care resumption, custody relief via consent decree. Bounded by national entry/document regime.

Governor's order endorses single-sex restrooms and changing rooms; marker changes need surgery; documented custody harm — trans woman celled with a male sex offender, court dismissing all claims as de minimis. No state GI hate-crime or discrimination statute.
